# Code of Conduct

We want this to be a friendly, respectful place to work, for people of every background.

- Be kind and patient. Assume good intent.
- Give feedback on the work, not the person.
- No harassment, insults, or discrimination of any kind.
- Respect people's privacy. Never share a member's personal details or photos without their permission.

If someone breaks these rules, report it to Saudimedicalailab@gmail.com. Maintainers may remove comments, close issues, or block people who do not follow them.

This text is a short, plain version based on the ideas of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org).
